From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP: Vendor enablement checklist for Greengrove - draft

Hi Elena — great to meet earlier today. Per our call, I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on vendor enablement / procurement steps so we can get you onto Redwood Dedicated with minimal friction. Attached is a working MAP (Redwood_MAP_v0.2.xlsx) and your W-9 template that I believe you wanted to confirm.

Draft milestones (high level):
- M1: Vendor forms + tax docs (W-9) — responsibility: Greengrove (owner: Elena) — target: 2026-07-26
- M2: Ariba/Coupa vendor registration completed — responsibility: Greengrove / Redwood vendor-ops (owner: procurement team) — target: 2026-07-30
- M3: Banking details & insurance evidence for payment setup — responsibility: Greengrove (owner: Elena / AP) — target: 2026-07-30
- M4: PO issued and initial reserved capacity scheduled — responsibility: Greengrove / Redwood sales ops (owner: Jasmine) — target close: 2026-08-05

Dependencies & notes:
- If Greengrove requires Ariba, we will initiate a vendor invite from our procurement portal; Greengrove will need to complete the vendor profile and upload W-9 + bank remit details.
- For faster payment processing, please provide ACH banking details and (if applicable) an EFT authorization form.
- Procurement windows at larger orgs sometimes push PO timelines by 10–15 business days — flag if you have a hard go-live date.

Ask: Can you confirm the AP contact who will complete the Ariba/Coupa steps and whether Greengrove prefers Ariba or Coupa? Also please confirm you received the attached W-9 form and the MAP draft.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (MAP draft), Greengrove_W-9.pdf (blank W-9)

Thanks — I’ll track next steps in HubSpot once you confirm.

Best,

Jasmine Liu

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor enablement checklist for Greengrove - draft

Elena / Jasmine — quick note from procurement enablement. I grabbed our Ariba/Coupa checklist and vendor instructions to make the path as clear as possible. Key points: 

- We will create an "invitation" from our Ariba tenant to the vendor contact (Daniel). Once Daniel receives it, he should: create an account, add company legal name, upload W-9, and fill bank remit fields. Our side requires: W-9, company EIN, and a copy of the bank voided check or ACH authorization for ACH payments (preferred).
- If Greengrove prefers Coupa instead, steps are similar but Coupa sometimes requires a portal code; please confirm preference so we send the correct invite.
- Internal Redwood contact for vendor ops: Praveen Shah (praveen.shah@redwood.com) — he will verify documents and mark the vendor "PAYABLE" which then triggers AP to accept PO.
- Typical internal turnaround at Redwood once vendor is verified: 2–3 business days to validate docs, then AP schedules payment terms.

I attached a short readme with step-by-step for Ariba: Vendor_Onboarding_Instructions_Ariba.txt

If you want, I can open the Ariba invite to Daniel this afternoon — Jasmine, say the word and I’ll send it.

Thanks,
Priyom
Lead, Procurement Enablement | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
